title: Type family architecture
slide_intent: Map a family by role because designers need to know which tools belong to which reading tasks.
strategic_value: Distinct Head, Text and additional styles can make Lufthansa type selection more consistent.
demonstration: Three columns list Head Bold, Light and Thin; Text Bold, Regular and Light; and Logotype plus Registration Mono.
practical_value: Choose the relevant branch of the family before selecting a weight.
